question:
Which two signs and two numbers should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct?

150 × 15 + 14 - 9 ÷ 2 = 6
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/952c967501c582f1911db7fefdaaefa9b6e3f505512624eb925e04e002be5a1f.png] 

Given : **150 × 15 + 14 - 9 ÷ 2 = 6**

So, after interchanging two signs and two numbers :

__
 
• Option - (1) : 9, 2, -, ×

150 - 15 + 14 × **2 ÷ 9**__ = 6

150 - 15 + __**14 × 0.22**__ = 6
